presentation.label: AIR CHORUS
presentation.summary: Chris Johnson's Airwindows Chorus, ported to Octatrack FX2 with smooth controls.
presentation.overview: Stereo sine-modulated delay with Chris Johnson’s original air compensation, three-point read and MIX/depth interaction, adapted to fixed-point DSP with smooth controls.
highlights: SPEED, RANGE and MIX with per-sample smoothing
usage: Select Air Chorus in audio-track FX2 SETUP.
Set MIX 0 to return to dry after the smoothing tail.

controls.name: SPD
controls.doc: Fourth-power free-running sine speed, 0–7.019 Hz; 64 is about 0.439 Hz. Per-sample smoothing.

controls.name: RNG
controls.doc: Fourth-power centre delay, 0–92.513 ms. At MIX 127 the modulation sweeps from zero to twice the centre. Two cascaded per-sample smoothing poles.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet, modulation depth and air compensation together. 0 settles to exact dry, 127 wet only; try 64 for the original plugin default. Two cascaded smoothing poles.

limitations: FX2 only; stale FX1 dispatch passes dry without writing its buffer.
About 16-bit delay-buffer precision; dry bypass retains 24 bits.
Extreme modulation retains pitch and aliasing artifacts.

Beta release: shared DSP mailbox/parameter data are protected. The reported T3 clicking remains unverified on hardware; physical timing, Part/project/reboot persistence and hardware multi-instance audio are owner-waived for this exact source/version.
Air Chorus combines with Analog BD and E-Verb. Available DSP code space still limits larger selections; stock reverb donors may be removed.

resources.recorded: 9 October 2026: lossless packing and shared-word protection; chip timing unmeasured.

storage.label: Per-instance used DSP storage
storage.conditions: Uses existing 16,384-word FX2 rings. First 72 virtual ring words use X offsets 60..131; 60 control words. Stock X offsets 132..255 remain untouched. Shared code/table use 795 P words per core (539 program + 256 lossless sine differences). No new allocation.

processing.label: Conservative DSP instruction budget
processing.conditions: Conservative source-word/call bound including trigger splits. Four instances plus four bounded initializations: 47,256 modeled units/core/block. Excludes contention stalls; not chip cycles or physical deadline evidence.

impact.conditions: Per active FX2 instance at expensive settings and moving controls, including the cold valid-history path; code/table shared per core, stock buffers reused. Estimates do not assert chip capacity or hardware headroom.

cpu.rationale: No authored ColdFire audio routine, heap, sequencer or callback; existing descriptor/editor/dispatcher paths deliver three target bytes. Shared loader/logger overhead is composition-wide.

dsp.rationale: Observed maximum 394.625 net executed instructions/sample versus stock Chorus 292.875 and expensive split Spring 314 under matched conditions on both cores. Shared-word protection and lossless table decoding increase cost 17.2% from beta 0.1.1 (336.75); still 24.8% below original 0.1.0 (524.5). Chip timing and physical headroom remain unmeasured.

memory.rationale: Full 16,384-word virtual stereo ring per instance, split between 16,312 Y and 72 X words; 60 additional control X words within safe offsets 0..131. Uses existing reservations and 795 P code/table words per core. No added sample heap.

tests.summary: Beta 0.1.2 protects live stock shared data within safe instance state and losslessly packs the sine table, preserving the full delay range, sound and controls while widening module combinations. Current physical hardware remains untested under the owner beta waiver.

tutorial.title: Tutorial: a slow chorus
steps: Select an audio track playing a sustained sound. Hold FUNC and press FX2, highlight Air Chorus with UP/DOWN, then press YES to assign it.
Press FX2. Set SPD 64 and RNG 64 with A/B, then raise MIX to 64 with F. Expect a slow chorus; sweep the controls to check for crackle.
Return MIX to 0 for dry after its smoothing tail, or select NONE in FX2 SETUP to remove the effect. Stop transport before saving your test configuration.

license.declaration: Chris Johnson's published Chorus source and full MIT copyright/permission notice are retained. The DSP56300 adaptation, tests and thumbnail are original work under MIT. No desktop binary, firmware, extracted stock routine/table or raw memory dump is included.

access.location: Audio-track FX2 SETUP; Air Chorus in the chooser.
steps: Use a disposable audio project and select a Flex or Static track.
Hold FUNC and press FX2, highlight Air Chorus with UP/DOWN, and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 and edit SPD with A, RNG with B and MIX with F.
Set MIX 0 for dry after the smoothing tail, or select NONE to remove it.
